description: Compact frequency inverter with Modbus RTU: monitoring, ramps and references, regulation, configuration, I/O, protections, motor, PID, SoftPLC and network control parameters
source: WEG CFW500 programming manual V2.2X and Modbus RTU manual

sources.title: WEG CFW500 Modbus RTU communication manual

sources.note: ranges, scales, units and read-only marks of the parameters added in revision 3

sources.title: WEG CFW500 programming manual (V2.0X), quick reference of parameters

notes: Every parameter Pxxxx is the holding register of the same number (P0003 is register 3); the Modicon address is 40001 + the number.
Values travel as integers: a parameter shown as 1.5 A is sent as 15. Scales in this map follow the decimal places of the programming manual.

Read from the programming manual V2.2X: 327 parameters with documented ranges. Parameters of the CAN, Ethernet and other network modules (P0700 and up, except P0680 to P0698) are not included; they are described in the module manuals.
P0001 and P0002 use the scale and unit chosen in P0208 to P0210, so they are shown raw.
P0682 and P0683 are written only through the serial interface, and the drive must be set to use serial as command and reference source (P0105 and P0220 to P0228).
P0312 = 2 selects Modbus RTU on the standard RS485 interface (default); a remote HMI uses the same port with P0312 = 0.
Parity and stop bits: P0311, default 1 = 8 data bits, even parity, 1 stop bit.
Parameters marked 'can be changed only with the motor stopped' are the manual's cfg parameters; the drive refuses a write while the motor runs.

A drive answers with an exception when a block of registers contains a parameter its firmware does not have, and the whole block fails. Parameters differ between firmware versions (V2.2X here); if a block fails, switch off the registers that the drive does not have (in Modbench: right-click, stop reading it).

bytes.0: 8 data bits, no parity, 1 stop bit
bytes.1: 8 data bits, even parity, 1 stop bit
bytes.2: 8 data bits, odd parity, 1 stop bit
bytes.3: 8 data bits, no parity, 2 stop bits
bytes.4: 8 data bits, even parity, 2 stop bits
bytes.5: 8 data bits, odd parity, 2 stop bits
